inputs: Current STL files, print-recipe.json and installed Bambu system presets; no prior 3MF or user preset is read by prepare_print.py.

recipe.process_name: Funnel mold - no brim - 0.16 mm slopes - 0.40 mm structure

z_trim.reason: User-observed build-plate calibration persists across nozzle, nozzle-size and material changes. Both offsets must be available; translucent PETG on the current plate uses +0.04 mm. Add the selected offset to the current stock machine's plate compensation.

enable_arc_fitting.reason: Bambu Studio disables arc fitting when syncing the connected machine's curve-planning enhancement. Save that firmware-compatible choice in the process and generate matching straight-segment toolpaths.

wall_generator.reason: Variable-width paths fill the 2.4 mm ribs and narrow transitions without relying on exact multiples of the nominal 0.82 mm bead.

wall_loops.reason: Four requested loops reinforce forming skins and hardware seats; all residual stock is also solid.

sparse_infill_density.reason: The CAD already contains open rib bays and air channels. All material left in its skins, ribs, arms and columns is structural stock.

sparse_infill_pattern.reason: Alternating rectilinear solid fill avoids crossing grid lines within a layer.

top_shell_layers.reason: Eight 0.40 mm layers provide 3.2 mm; the independent physical minimum also covers fine-layer bands.

bottom_shell_layers.reason: Eight 0.40 mm layers provide 3.2 mm; the independent physical minimum also covers fine-layer bands.

top_shell_thickness.reason: Maintain the modeled forming-skin thickness as solid surface stock through variable layer heights.

bottom_shell_thickness.reason: Maintain the modeled forming-skin thickness as solid surface stock through variable layer heights.

top_one_wall_type.reason: Retain requested wall loops where hardware seats and the parting plate reach a top surface.

top_surface_speed.reason: A deliberate finishing-speed target for flat forming surfaces and hardware seats; physical finish is checked with the witnesses.

seam_gap.reason: A closed conventional seam avoids intentionally removing material where skins and loaded walls join. Scarf seams remain disabled by the stock presets.

brim_type.reason: Permanent rounded feet, an 8 mm perimeter frame and 6.4 mm rib lands provide bed contact as connected structural material. The user's brim lifted during the cavity print.

brim_width.reason: No removable brim is generated around any object.

skirt_loops.reason: No separate skirt is needed; retain the machine's stock nozzle-cleaning and priming sequence.

enable_prime_tower.reason: Each plate uses one filament and one nozzle, with no material changes.

filament_prime_volume.reason: Explicitly retain the 45 mm3 value in the verified slice so the installed filament preset and project agree. These plates have no prime tower or material changes.

nozzle_temperature.reason: 255 C is within the manufacturer's PETG Translucent range and provides melting margin for the proposed 18 mm3/s high-flow setting. Verify the actual dry spool and nozzle with the witnesses and flow calibration.

nozzle_temperature_initial_layer.reason: Use the same melt temperature for the stock 0.40 mm first layer and the remaining print.

filament_max_volumetric_speed.reason: Standard retains the vendor's 16 mm3/s. High Flow uses the user's proposed 18 mm3/s as a calibration target, not a measured capacity claim.

filament_cost.reason: The hardware ledger's acquired Bambu PETG cost per kilogram; this affects cost estimates only.

outer_wall_speed.reason: Limit the forming faces, registration and hardware fits to a defined surface-speed target while reinforcement uses the stock process speeds and volumetric cap.

outer_wall_acceleration.reason: Reduce acceleration at forming and fit surfaces to limit ringing; the value is an engineering starting point verified on the physical witnesses.

finish-witness.reason: Represent the mold's fine layers around the backing channels.
Bridge roof and the full 15-degree finishing ramp.

cavity.reason: Three-millimetre backing-air channels and their crowns.
Blind spout tip and pocket floor.
The full shallow underside and forming ramp, including a margin beyond their analytic face bounds.
Washer-seat floors and the finished upper datum.

core.reason: Backing-air channels and their crowns in the inverted print orientation.
Square-nut side entries, retaining lips and the parting face.
The full shallow underside and forming ramp, rod socket and working-stroke marks in the inverted print orientation.

hardware-witness.reason: Reproduce the core's initial layer schedule.
Reproduce the core's square-nut slots and retaining lips.

bottom_shell_layers.reason: Eight 0.40 mm layers provide 3.2 mm; the independent physical minimum also covers fine-layer bands.

bottom_shell_thickness.reason: Maintain the modeled forming-skin thickness as solid surface stock through variable layer heights.

brim_type.reason: Permanent rounded feet, an 8 mm perimeter frame and 6.4 mm rib lands provide bed contact as connected structural material. The user's brim lifted during the cavity print.

brim_width.reason: No removable brim is generated around any object.
